# Pocket

> Pocket is a private personal finance app for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. It computes net worth, cash flow, investments, goals, debt and tax on your own device, from the numbers you enter or import, and can show the working behind its figures. It is built by an independent, India-based project.

Facts that the pages below state:

- Local-first: the financial database stays on your device. There is no Pocket account and no Pocket server; nothing is uploaded by default.
- Live market prices, hosted AI and the update check (which asks mypocketfi.com for the latest version number) are off until you switch them on.
- On Windows, Pocket can encrypt its database and backups (SQLCipher, AES-256) when you turn that on, with a recovery passphrase only you hold. The Android app always encrypts its database and asks for no internet access.
- Downloads: a Windows installer, a macOS disk image (Apple silicon), Linux .deb and AppImage, and an Android APK, each with its SHA-256 on the Download page. Not yet code-signed.
- Pocket reports figures, targets and gaps. It does not place trades or tell you to buy or sell, and it is not financial advice.
- Plans: a Free plan that stays usable, Founder Pro (monthly or yearly), and a one-time Lifetime Founder licence. Paid plans are activated by an offline, signed licence key.
- Support: support@mypocketfi.com, or the Contact page.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://mypocketfi.com/guides.html): money in India, worked through with figures from Pocket
- [Changelog](https://mypocketfi.com/changelog.html): every published version of Pocket, newest first; RSS at https://mypocketfi.com/feed.xml
- [How to work out your net worth in India](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-net-worth-india.html): what counts, where each figure comes from, and a full example with the mistakes that move the number.
- [Track your mutual funds from a CAMS or KFintech statement](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-mutual-fund-statement.html): getting the detailed CAS, how Pocket checks every fund's lines, and why a fund can be left out.
- [Old vs new tax regime, worked through](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-old-vs-new-tax-regime.html): FY 2026-27's slabs, the ₹12 lakh rebate and its marginal relief, and when the old regime costs less.
- [A budget app that never asks for your bank login](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-budget-without-bank-login.html): budgeting from your bank's CSV statement: what Pocket reads, files and suggests, on your own device.
- [HRA exemption, worked through](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-hra-exemption.html): the least of three limits, in Mumbai and in Jaipur, how the rent changes it, and what it does to the tax.
- [80D: health insurance, by whom a policy covers](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-80d-health-insurance.html): the two limits, parents over 60, which of four policies count, and what 80D does to the year's tax.
- [80C and ELSS within the ₹1.5 lakh limit](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-80c-elss.html): what counts, how much EPF already uses, what each rupee of 80C is worth, and where ELSS fits.
- [Capital gains on mutual funds and shares, worked through](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-capital-gains-tax.html): holding periods and rates, units sold oldest first, a year's three sales, and the tax on them.
- [The ₹1.25 lakh LTCG room, worked through](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-ltcg-exemption.html): the tax-free equity long-term gain, the room left after gains booked, and what is long-term in a holding now.
- [Advance tax: the dates and the amounts](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-advance-tax.html): who pays, the four dates, the amount due by each, and a salaried person with a capital gain.
- [From CTC to take-home pay, worked through](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-ctc-to-take-home.html): basic, HRA, PF, gratuity, professional tax and TDS on one salary, a month and a year.
- [NPS and 80CCD(1B), worked through](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-nps-80ccd-1b.html): the three NPS deductions, what the extra ₹50,000 saves, and what a monthly contribution could grow to.
- [How your EPF grows](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-epf-growth.html): what goes in each month, how the balance compounds over 30 years, and what the projection assumes.
- [PPF over 15 years, worked through](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-ppf-15-years.html): the deposit limits, how interest is worked out, ₹1.5 lakh a year to maturity, and extensions.
- [Step-up vs flat SIP, worked through](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-step-up-vs-flat-sip.html): what a SIP that rises each year pays in and builds, against one that stays the same, month by month.
- [The cost of starting a SIP late, worked through](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-cost-of-starting-a-sip-late.html): what starting 12 months, two years or five years late costs at the same finish date, month by month.
- [How much you need to retire, and the year you reach it](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-retirement-corpus-fire.html): a year's spending grown with inflation over a withdrawal rate, and the first year a step-up SIP covers it.
- [The SIP a goal needs, worked through](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-goal-sip.html): a goal's cost grown with inflation, the money already set aside, and the monthly SIP that reaches it.
- [An emergency fund in months, worked through](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-emergency-fund-months.html): essential spending as a target, the months a fund covers, how long it takes to fill, and what prices do to it.
- [Paying off loans: snowball and avalanche, worked through](https://mypocketfi.com/guide-loan-snowball-avalanche.html): smallest balance first or highest rate first: what each order costs in interest and months, month by month.
- [Old vs new tax regime calculator](https://mypocketfi.com/calc-tax-regime.html): income tax on your salary for FY 2026-27 under both regimes, every step shown: deductions, slabs, the ₹12 lakh rebate, surcharge and cess.
- [SIP calculator](https://mypocketfi.com/calc-sip.html): a SIP calculator that shows its working: start-of-month instalments, a yearly step-up, year-by-year values and the cost of starting late.
- [Net worth calculator](https://mypocketfi.com/calc-net-worth.html): work out your net worth: investments, bank, EPF, PPF, NPS, gold and property, less every loan and card, added up line by line.
- [Glossary](https://mypocketfi.com/glossary.html): 28 terms from the guides and calculators, from 80C to XIRR, each with the pages that use it.
